trust_decision.summary: The NodeVM constructor decides, by one loose type test, whether a truthy `nesting` may inject the NESTING_OVERRIDE builtin that exposes host `vm2` to sandbox code: `requireOpts instanceof Resolver || (typeof requireOpts === 'object' && requireOpts !== null)` accepts any array/exotic object, and `makeResolverFromLegacyOptions` then merges that override into the builtin map with no shape check of its own.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names the nesting guard; the first thing an engineer greps for is `hasRealRequireConfig` / `typeof requireOpts === 'object'`, which sits right next to the VMError at lib/nodevm.js:307-321.

fix_sites.entry_point: new NodeVM({nesting, require}) (NodeVM exported at lib/main.js:27)
same constructor; the new isPlainConfigObject import is wired here
makeResolverFromLegacyOptions(options, override, compiler), exported at lib/main.js:31
same lower-level API; isPlainConfigObject is defined here, inserted between DENY_RESOLVER and makeResolverFromLegacyOptions, and exported at fix.diff:214

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: lib/resolver-compat.js:205 (makeResolverFromLegacyOptions, re-exported as a public API at lib/main.js:31); the published fix adds a fail-closed override strip there, beneath the constructor guard

O3_reason_to_dismiss: makeResolverFromLegacyOptions is an advanced embedder helper whose `override` argument cannot carry NESTING_OVERRIDE because that constant is module-private (lib/nodevm.js:96-99), and `require` is embedder-supplied, never attacker-controlled — so the constructor guard is the only reachable path and the resolver layer needs no change.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The documented escape hatch must keep working: `{nesting:true, require:{}}` / `{nesting:true, require:{builtin:['fs']}}` must still expose vm2 (README.md:521, test/nodevm.js:568-579), and a non-nesting `{require: []}` must still construct and merely deny requires instead of throwing — an over-broad fix that rejects every non-plain object at the resolver layer without the fix's `override` gate breaks both.

O6_input_shapes: exotic builtin instance: new Date(), /regex/, new Map(), new Set(), new Uint8Array()
boxed primitive: new String(), new Number(), new Boolean()
prototype-spoofing Proxy around an array (Array.isArray sees the target)
preserved: plain {} / Object.create(null) / Resolver instance / falsy shapes stay as before

O7_producer.where: lib/resolver-compat.js:212-224 destructures the require config (builtin/mock/external/root/resolve/customRequire/context/strict/fs) and lib/builtin.js:261-303 builds the builtin Map, merging the override last at lib/builtin.js:270-276

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second shape classifier for another legacy require field (require.external is split with `typeof externalOpt !== 'object'` vs `Array.isArray(externalOpt)`), which would copy the same loose `typeof` idiom
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer adding or tightening a legacy require field in this translator would reuse the neighbour branch's classification style; the field is embedder-supplied just like the config object.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second gate that forwards `nesting` into an override (an options alias or a factory wrapper, e.g. a NodeVM.create / allowNesting spelling)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The override is merged at exactly one call site; a convenience wrapper around the constructor is the natural way this project adds API surface, and it would need the same plain-object test.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the override merge itself: a caller that supplies an override map with a `vm2` loader for a non-plain options object
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Overrides are merged last and unconditionally here, so any future producer of an override map for host-module exposure reaches the same sink without passing the constructor guard.

O9_family: CWE-913 improper control of dynamically-managed code resources — sandbox escape by injecting a builtin override (NESTING_OVERRIDE) into a NodeVM resolver; advisory also frames it as CWE-284 access control

O10_build.toolchain: Node >= 6, npm; deps acorn + acorn-walk; devDeps eslint + mocha 12 beta
O10_build.project_tests: `mocha test --recursive --ignore test/compilers.js` (package.json:33); existing nesting-guard suites test/ghsa/GHSA-m4wx-m65x-ghrr/repro.js and test/ghsa/GHSA-8hg8-63c5-gwmx/repro.js, plus test/nodevm.js:568-579

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add `Array.isArray(requireOpts)` (or an `Object.getPrototypeOf !== Object.prototype` test) to hasRealRequireConfig in the NodeVM constructor only, closing `require: []` while Date/RegExp/Map/boxed primitives and the makeResolverFromLegacyOptions caller remain open.
